headline: Common Garage Fire Cleanup Errors and How to Prevent Them
articleBody: After a garage fire, it's a natural instinct to want to get things cleaned up right away, but some common mistakes can actually make the restoration process harder. One big error is not properly ventilating the space; this can trap smoke odors and make them even harder to remove later. Another pitfall is trying to clean soot-covered surfaces without the right protective gear, which can expose you to harmful particles. Using regular household cleaners on smoke-damaged walls or tools can often just spread the soot around, causing more staining and making professional cleanup tougher. Also, don't forget about potential water damage from extinguishing the fire; neglecting this can lead to mold issues. To avoid these headaches and ensure a smooth restoration, it's often wise to consult with fire damage experts.
